description: LiveCodeBench style (JavaScript): cheapest route in a directed graph with at most k toll roads. It needs a search over (junction, tolls used) states with a heap; exhaustive route enumeration fails the large cases, which run in a separate process with a hard kill timeout, and so does a plain Dijkstra that forgets the toll count. Hidden edges cover directed roads, parallel roads and self loops, zero cost roads, src equal to dst, boolean toll flags, a k of one billion that must not size arrays by k, argument validation and a randomized comparison with an exhaustive reference.
